supporting_pages.title: Firestore overview \_|\_ Firestore in Native mode \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: Expressive querying In Firestore in Native Mode, you can use queries to retrieve individual, specific documents or to retrieve all the documents in a collection that match your query parameters.
Designed to scale Firestore in Native Mode brings you automatic multi-region data replication, strongly-consistent queries, atomic batch operations, and transaction support.
Key capabilities Flexibility The Firestore in Native Mode data model supports flexible, hierarchical data structures.
